name: Host board
summary: A host view of who's coming, plus-ones, capacity and snacks for a house party, with a door list that locks once it fits.
useWhen: hosting a party at a place with a rough cap
'how many people are actually coming', 'can people bring a plus-one', 'how much pizza do we need'
dontUseWhen: a ticketed event or venue (use squad-lock)
splitting the cost of the snacks (use split-purchase)

params.title: event name
params.door: who checks the list at the door
params.guests: names of outside guests for the door list
params.rate: 0 one in 4, 1 one in 2, 2 three in 4
